articles.headline: Silly Season Shakes Up The Grid Before A Single Lap Is Turned
articles.dek: A fresh wave of driver movement reshapes the Cup Series roster just ahead of the 2028 season opener.
articles.body:
The offseason garage shuffle has finally settled, leaving the Cup Series grid looking entirely different before the first green flag of 2028. While the points race has not yet begun, teams have locked in their garage pairings and final paint schemes. The moves reshape several key organizations from top to bottom.

Front Row Motorsports had to rebuild after Noah Gragson dropped down to the O'Reilly Auto Parts Series to drive the Peterson Racing number 87. Filling that vacancy is Corey Day, who moves up to the Cup Series to pilot the Front Row Motorsports number 4. Day brings fresh talent to the organization as it looks to make noise right out of the box.

Over at Kaulig Racing, the departure of AJ Allmendinger following his retirement left a massive leadership void. Kaulig tapped Sammy Smith to make the jump to the Cup Series in the number 16 machine, stepping up from JR Motorsports. It is a massive test for Smith as he steps into the top tier of simulated stock car racing.

Meanwhile, Ryan Preece stays put at RFK Racing, putting an end to the paddock chatter that had him moving elsewhere. With the roster finalized and sponsors locked in, the focus shifts entirely to the track. Preseason testing is over, and the real work begins when the hauler doors open for race one.
articles.author: Cole Whitaker

pullQuote.text: The roster is locked and everyone is about to find out where they stand.
